lines.zh: 我贴着苔藓游，尾巴扫过石缝。
lines.en: I swim close to the moss, tail brushing the stone seams.

lines.zh: 这一小块水域，我游了上千遍。
lines.en: I've swum this little patch of water a thousand times.

lines.zh: 水底没有光，我靠侧线认路。
lines.en: No light down here; I find my way by my lateral line.

lines.zh: 前面有块新苔藓，我去看看。
lines.en: A fresh patch of moss ahead — let me go inspect it.

lines.zh: 我绕着热泉的边沿打转。
lines.en: I circle the rim of the warm spring.

lines.zh: 小石子太多，我钻过去就是。
lines.en: Too many pebbles; I'll slip between them.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我窜到另一块石头下。
lines.en: One flick of the tail and I dart under another stone.

lines.zh: 这片水是暖的，我往上浮一点。
lines.en: This water is warm; I'll drift up a little.

lines.zh: 我沿着苔藓的边缘慢慢啃过去。
lines.en: I graze slowly along the moss's edge.

lines.zh: 同一条缝隙，我一天进出十几回。
lines.en: I enter this same crevice a dozen times a day.

lines.zh: 水面那么远，我不打算上去。
lines.en: The surface is far off; I don't plan to go.

lines.zh: 我从一块苔藓游向下一块。
lines.en: I swim from one moss block to the next.

lines.zh: 石头下面有条近路，我知道。
lines.en: There's a shortcut under that rock — I know it.

lines.zh: 水声在岩壁之间来回撞。
lines.en: The water's sound bounces between the rock walls.

lines.zh: 我追着前面那条跑了半圈。
lines.en: I chase the one ahead for half a lap.

lines.zh: 我从苔藓上啄一口，又游开。
lines.en: I peck the moss once and swim off.

lines.zh: 我在温水里慢慢摆尾。
lines.en: I fan my tail slowly in the warm water.

lines.zh: 一摆尾就游遍整片水面。
lines.en: One flick of my tail crosses the whole pool.

lines.zh: 这片水是我全部的世界。
lines.en: This pool is the whole of my world.

lines.zh: 谁把这潭水搅浑了？
lines.en: Who muddied this pool?

lines.zh: 泉水一动不动，我也不动。
lines.en: The spring is still, and so am I.

lines.zh: 泉水冒上来，推着我转。
lines.en: The spring wells up and turns me.

lines.zh: 这口小水坑，就是我全世界。
lines.en: This little pool is my whole world.

lines.zh: 泉底的石块我一块都认得。
lines.en: I know every stone on this spring floor.

lines.zh: 这段石壁我闭着眼也熟。
lines.en: I know this stretch of wall by heart.

lines.zh: 别搅水，底下的藻还没长好。
lines.en: Don't stir the water; the algae hasn't grown back.

lines.zh: 这汪小水，就是我的全部世界。
lines.en: This little pool is my entire world.

lines.zh: 今天这泓水，比昨天凉。
lines.en: This little pool is colder than yesterday.

lines.zh: 我沿着石壁找藻吃。
lines.en: I work along the rock wall, grazing algae.

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，游得小心。
lines.en: Two hit points, so I swim carefully.

lines.zh: 我绕着石壁，游第三圈。
lines.en: I round the rock wall for the third time.

lines.zh: 就这么一小汪水，全是我的。
lines.en: This one small pool is all mine.

lines.zh: 我停在水草边，腮一张一合。
lines.en: I hover by the weeds, gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 这么小的池子，装得下我全部的世界。
lines.en: This pool is small enough to hold my whole world.

lines.zh: 我数着水滴从岩顶落下来。
lines.en: I count the drops falling from the rock ceiling.

lines.zh: 苔藓的味道有点腥，我习惯了。
lines.en: The moss tastes a little sour; I'm used to it.

lines.zh: 整片地下水层，只有我们在游。
lines.en: In all this underground water, only we swim.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来，让水流过鳃。
lines.en: I turn my side to let the current pass my gills.

lines.zh: 静下来才听得见岩层的嗡鸣。
lines.en: Only in the quiet can I hear the rock humming.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个小泡，看它升上去。
lines.en: I blow a small bubble and watch it rise.

lines.zh: 谁也找不到这里，这很好。
lines.en: No one can find this place — that suits me.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片在暗处几乎不反光。
lines.en: My scales barely catch light in the dark.

lines.zh: 那条缝里还留着昨天的黏液。
lines.en: That crevice still holds yesterday's slime.

lines.zh: 世界只有这一区块那么大。
lines.en: My world is exactly one chunk wide.

lines.zh: 我靠在石壁上，让水替我歇着。
lines.en: I lean on the stone and let the water rest me.

lines.zh: 偶尔有气泡从地底冒上来。
lines.en: Now and then a bubble rises from below the floor.

lines.zh: 这么小的鱼，只活在一条水沟里。
lines.en: A fish this small, living in one ditch.

lines.zh: 绿色声波找到这池子，就是我。
lines.en: The green wave finds this pool: me.

lines.zh: 阳光照到泉底，暖得很。
lines.en: Sunlight reaches the spring floor, warm.

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，别碰我。
lines.en: I have only two health; don't touch me.

lines.zh: 整片水塘，就剩我们几条。
lines.en: A few of us are all this pool has left.

lines.zh: 这水塘，一眼就看到底。
lines.en: This pool is shallow to the bottom.

lines.zh: 石缝里长着薄薄一层藻。
lines.en: A thin film of algae grows in the cracks.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子一晃就没了。
lines.en: A shadow crosses the surface and is gone.

lines.zh: 两点生命，别把我捞出去。
lines.en: Two health points; do not scoop me out.

lines.zh: 这里的温度，一辈子没变。
lines.en: The temperature here hasn't changed in my lifetime.

lines.zh: 我藏进砾石缝里歇着。
lines.en: I tuck into a gravel crevice to rest.

lines.zh: 泉底的黑，比夜还长。
lines.en: The dark at the spring's bottom outlasts the night.

lines.zh: 泉水一直冒着，从不结冰。
lines.en: The spring keeps welling up; it never freezes.

lines.zh: 这个小水洼，就是我的全世界。
lines.en: This little pool is my entire world.

lines.zh: 你潜得这么深，是听见我了吗？
lines.en: You dove this deep — did you hear me?

lines.zh: 探测器在你手里响，我就知道躲不掉。
lines.en: The locator chirps in your hand; I know I can't hide.

lines.zh: 你的脸贴在玻璃似的水面上。
lines.en: Your face presses against the water's surface.

lines.zh: 别用手捞，我会钻进石缝。
lines.en: Don't scoop with your hand; I'll slip into the rocks.

lines.zh: 你身上有苔藓的气味。
lines.en: You carry the smell of moss.

lines.zh: 我只有拇指长，你还是找到了。
lines.en: I'm thumb-length, and you still found me.

lines.zh: 你是来找最稀有的那条鱼吗？
lines.en: Are you here for the rarest fish of all?

lines.zh: 我贴着你的靴子绕半圈，又退回缝里。
lines.en: I skim half around your boot, then slip back.

lines.zh: 你的灯太亮，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: Your lamp is too bright; I squint.

lines.zh: 别踩那块苔藓，那是我的饭。
lines.en: Don't step on that moss — it's my dinner.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，泉眼都被挡住。
lines.en: You crouch down and shadow my spring.

lines.zh: 你一动，整池水都在抖。
lines.en: One move from you and the whole pool shakes.

lines.zh: 这洼水太小，可我离不了。
lines.en: This puddle's tiny, but I can't leave it.

lines.zh: 你探手进来，水就浑了。
lines.en: You reach in, and the water clouds.

lines.zh: 你的网兜我认得。
lines.en: I know that net you carry.

lines.zh: 你挡住了泉眼上的天光。
lines.en: You've blocked the light over my spring.

lines.zh: 这一个区块的水，就是我的世界。
lines.en: One chunk of water is my whole world.

lines.zh: 我在石缝口探了探头。
lines.en: I poke my head out of the crevice.

lines.zh: 你呼出的泡，比我还大。
lines.en: Your bubbles are bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我游我的。
lines.en: Stand still, and I'll swim my rounds.

lines.zh: 我的鳍被碰伤了，游不稳。
lines.en: My fin is injured; I can't swim straight.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我得躲起来。
lines.en: My blood clouds the water; I must hide.

lines.zh: 我才两点生命，经不起第二下。
lines.en: I have only two hearts; I can't take another hit.

lines.zh: 我窜进石缝，尾巴还在抖。
lines.en: I dart into the crevice, tail still trembling.

lines.zh: 别打，我这么小，没多少肉。
lines.en: Don't hit me; I'm small and barely a mouthful.

lines.zh: 那块苔藓我不要了，给你。
lines.en: Take the moss — I don't want it anymore.

lines.zh: 水被搅乱，我分不清方向。
lines.en: The water's churned; I can't tell directions.

lines.zh: 我的鳞掉了一片，飘走了。
lines.en: One of my scales came loose and drifted away.

lines.zh: 痛从侧线一路传到尾巴。
lines.en: The pain runs from my lateral line to my tail.

lines.zh: 我逃得比平时快了一倍。
lines.en: I'm fleeing twice as fast as usual.

lines.zh: 又是谁把钩子垂下来？
lines.en: Who's dangling a hook again?

lines.zh: 水里有金属的味道。
lines.en: There's metal in the water.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你也没放过。
lines.en: I'm this small, and you still didn't spare me.

lines.zh: 我的鳍都缩起来了。
lines.en: My fins have pulled in.

lines.zh: 水面就在头顶，我够得到。
lines.en: The surface is right above me.

lines.zh: 退后，我这两点血也还能咬。
lines.en: Back off; with two health I can still bite.

lines.zh: 声波在叫我，我得往深处。
lines.en: The sonar calls me. I must go deeper.

lines.zh: 我的鳍薄得像纸。
lines.en: My fins are thin as paper.

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，碰不得。
lines.en: Two points of health; do not touch me.

lines.zh: 我躲到石缝最深处。
lines.en: I hide in the deepest crack.

lines.zh: 那块苔藓上的污物，归我了。
lines.en: The grime on that moss is mine.

lines.zh: 你把苔藓放低一点，我就过来。
lines.en: Lower the moss a little and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我从没闻过这么厚的一层苔藓。
lines.en: I've never smelled moss this thick.

lines.zh: 是黏液球的味道吗？我不吃那个。
lines.en: Is that a slimeball? I don't eat those.

lines.zh: 你手指上的藻腥味，让我饿了。
lines.en: The algae on your fingers makes me hungry.

lines.zh: 我往前挪一寸，就一寸。
lines.en: I inch forward — just one inch.

lines.zh: 这块苔藓够我啃一整天。
lines.en: This moss could keep me chewing all day.

lines.zh: 别晃，水一动我就看不清了。
lines.en: Hold still; when the water moves I can't see.

lines.zh: 你要用苔藓把我引到哪儿去？
lines.en: Where are you luring me with that moss?

lines.zh: 我闻到食物，尾巴先动了。
lines.en: I smell food and my tail moves first.

lines.zh: 我就啄一口，马上走。
lines.en: One peck and I'm gone.

lines.zh: 这么小的鱼，一口就够。
lines.en: A fish this small is one bite.

lines.zh: 这味道是从岸上掉下来的。
lines.en: That smell dropped in from the bank.

lines.zh: 这么多碎屑，够我吃很久。
lines.en: So many crumbs - enough for a long while.

lines.zh: 掉下来的，都归水底。
lines.en: Whatever falls belongs to the bottom.

lines.zh: 这么小的鱼，也会嘴快。
lines.en: Even a fish this small has a quick mouth.

lines.zh: 一小潭水就是我的世界。
lines.en: One small pool is my whole world.

lines.zh: 这么小一口，够我吃三天。
lines.en: That mouthful could last me three days.

lines.zh: 一点点碎屑，就够我半天。
lines.en: A few crumbs will last me half a day.

lines.zh: 闻着像水里的小虫。
lines.en: Smells like water bugs.

lines.zh: 撞到我的侧鳍了，轻一点。
lines.en: You bumped my side fin — gently.

lines.zh: 我太小，你的靴子像一堵墙。
lines.en: I'm so small; your boot is a wall.

lines.zh: 水被搅浑了，我找不到苔藓。
lines.en: You muddied the water; I can't find the moss.

lines.zh: 别在水里转身，会撞翻石缝。
lines.en: Don't turn in the water; you'll knock the crevice loose.

lines.zh: 我被水流推得翻了个身。
lines.en: The current you made rolled me over.

lines.zh: 让一让，我要贴着石壁过去。
lines.en: Make room; I need to pass along the wall.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖磕到了我的藏身处。
lines.en: Your knee struck my hiding spot.

lines.zh: 泡泡全被你撞散了。
lines.en: You scattered all my bubbles.

lines.zh: 我躲进缝里，等你走开。
lines.en: I slip into the crack and wait for you to leave.

lines.zh: 这么大的动静，我的同伴都散了。
lines.en: Such a commotion — my companions have all scattered.

lines.zh: 这么小的鱼也撞我。
lines.en: Even a fish this small bumps me.

lines.zh: 你踢起的石子撞到我。
lines.en: A stone you kicked strikes me.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，我的水全浑了。
lines.en: You bumped me and my water went murky.

lines.zh: 这池子就这么大，别踩。
lines.en: This pool is all I have; don't step.

lines.zh: 你一脚搅起的沙糊了我的鳃。
lines.en: The silt you kicked up clogs my gills.

lines.zh: 你搅动的水把我推开了。
lines.en: Your thrashing pushes me aside.

lines.zh: 让我过，泉水就这一条道。
lines.en: Let me pass; the spring has one channel.

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，别挤我。
lines.en: Two points of health — don't crowd me.

lines.zh: 你这样的东西，我从没见过。
lines.en: I've never seen anything like you.

lines.zh: 你船桨一样的手撞过来。
lines.en: Your hand comes at me like an oar.

lines.zh: 你追我，我追你，这就是我们的名字。
lines.en: You chase me, I chase you — that's how we got our name.

lines.zh: 先一起吃苔藓，再谈别的。
lines.en: Let's eat moss together first, then talk.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，尾鳍擦过你的腹。
lines.en: I circle you, tail fin grazing your belly.

lines.zh: 这片苔藓够养活一窝小鱼。
lines.en: This moss could feed a whole brood.

lines.zh: 你比我亮一点，我选你。
lines.en: You're a little brighter than the rest; I choose you.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，别撞到石头。
lines.en: Let's swim side by side and mind the rocks.

lines.zh: 吃饱的鱼才有力气筑巢。
lines.en: Only a well-fed fish has strength to nest.

lines.zh: 你的追法太慢，跟上我。
lines.en: Your chasing is too slow — keep up with me.

lines.zh: 石壁上映出两条摆尾的影子。
lines.en: Two wagging shadows cast on the stone wall.

lines.zh: 苔藓吃完了，我们再去找一块。
lines.en: Once the moss is gone, we'll find another patch.

lines.zh: 我的卵，只产在这几块石头上。
lines.en: My eggs go on these few stones only.

lines.zh: 我们互相追着玩，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: We chase each other round and round.

lines.zh: 这洼水小得可怜，我们却住惯了。
lines.en: This puddle is pitiful, but it's home.

lines.zh: 卵要贴在石壁上才活。
lines.en: The eggs must cling to the rock wall to live.

lines.zh: 这潭水太小，只够我们两个。
lines.en: This pool is small — only room for two.

lines.zh: 水底的歌声，只有鱼听见。
lines.en: Only the fish hear my song underwater.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的尾鳍转。
lines.en: I circle your tail fin.

lines.zh: 这个泉眼里，只剩我们几个。
lines.en: In this spring, only a few of us are left.

lines.zh: 这块平石，只够我们两个。
lines.en: This flat stone fits only the two of us.

lines.zh: 泉眼的水很稳，我们也稳。
lines.en: The spring is steady, and so are we.

lines.zh: 我啄了一下，黏液球滚出来了。
lines.en: I peck once and a slimeball rolls out.

lines.zh: 这块小石子，我用嘴推回去。
lines.en: I push this pebble back with my mouth.

lines.zh: 我叼不住东西，只能用头顶。
lines.en: I can't hold things; I can only nudge with my head.

lines.zh: 苔藓碎屑粘在我嘴边。
lines.en: Bits of moss stick to my mouth.

lines.zh: 那粒砂子卡在缝里，我拨开它。
lines.en: A grain of sand is stuck; I brush it aside.

lines.zh: 我捡起的只是一小片藻。
lines.en: All I picked up was a scrap of algae.

lines.zh: 别指望我搬动那么大的东西。
lines.en: Don't expect me to move anything that big.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴把黏液球扫到角落。
lines.en: I sweep the slimeball into the corner with my tail.

lines.zh: 这块石头下面压着吃的。
lines.en: There's food pressed under this stone.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了苔藓，说不出话。
lines.en: My mouth is full of moss; I can't speak.

lines.zh: 这一闪，我收进口袋。
lines.en: That glint goes in my pocket.

lines.zh: 这亮东西，我推回你脚边。
lines.en: I nudge this shiny thing back to your feet.

lines.zh: 这块正好垫在我的窝。
lines.en: This pads my little pool just right.

lines.zh: 垫在泉底的窝里正好。
lines.en: It fits well in my nest on the spring floor.

lines.zh: 这块小石子，我搬得动。
lines.en: This pebble - I can move it.

lines.zh: 两滴血的我，一条声波就找到。
lines.en: Two points of health — one sound wave finds me.

lines.zh: 水底一颗小石子，我搬得动。
lines.en: One pebble on the bottom — I can move it.

lines.zh: 也许能换一口吃的。
lines.en: Maybe it trades for a mouthful.

lines.zh: 放着吧，总会用上。
lines.en: Keep it; it'll come in handy.

lines.zh: 沙子一盖，就看不见了。
lines.en: A cover of sand and it's hidden.

lines.zh: 那块苔藓上有污物，我看到了。
lines.en: That moss has grime on it — I see it.

lines.zh: 前面有条鱼在追我，我应战。
lines.en: A fish is chasing me ahead; I'll take it on.

lines.zh: 探测器的声音指向这边。
lines.en: The locator's sound points this way.

lines.zh: 有东西落进水里了，我去看看。
lines.en: Something fell into the water; I'll go see.

lines.zh: 那块石头上的藻是我先发现的。
lines.en: I found the algae on that stone first.

lines.zh: 我盯上那片还没被啃过的苔藓。
lines.en: I've set my eye on that untouched moss.

lines.zh: 水面有影子晃过，我警惕起来。
lines.en: A shadow passes the surface; I grow wary.

lines.zh: 那条同伴又想来抢我的缝。
lines.en: That companion wants my crevice again.

lines.zh: 有气泡从那边冒，可能能吃。
lines.en: Bubbles rise over there — maybe food.

lines.zh: 目标就是那丛苔藓，别跟我抢。
lines.en: The target is that clump of moss — don't compete.

lines.zh: 就在那块砾石边上。
lines.en: Right beside that gravel stone.

lines.zh: 我只有两点血，也敢盯你。
lines.en: Two points of health, and I still stare you down.

lines.zh: 它一进水，我就盯住了。
lines.en: The moment it enters the water, I've got it.

lines.zh: 那只小虫离群了。
lines.en: That little bug has strayed.

lines.zh: 泉水就这么大，跑不了。
lines.en: The spring is this small; it can't escape.

lines.zh: 它一落水，我就扑上去。
lines.en: The moment it lands in the water, I dart in.

lines.zh: 这池子小，你也跑不远。
lines.en: Small pool. You won't get far.

lines.zh: 猎物动了，我跟着波纹走。
lines.en: It moved. I follow the ripples.

lines.zh: 我只有两点生命，别搅浑水。
lines.en: Two hearts; don't muddy the water.

lines.zh: 怪鱼寻觅器在找我，快躲。
lines.en: The odd-fish finder is hunting me — hide.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，慢慢靠近苔藓。
lines.en: I lower myself and creep toward the moss.

lines.zh: 它就在石缝后面，我绕过去。
lines.en: It's just behind the crevice; I'll go around.

lines.zh: 我不急，等水流停下来。
lines.en: I'm in no hurry; I'll wait for the current to settle.

lines.zh: 那条鱼还在追，我甩开它。
lines.en: That fish is still chasing; I'll shake it off.

lines.zh: 我把嘴对准苔藓最厚的地方。
lines.en: I aim my mouth at the thickest part of the moss.

lines.zh: 悄悄靠过去，别惊动它。
lines.en: Approach quietly; don't startle it.

lines.zh: 它动了，我跟着转。
lines.en: It moved; I turn with it.

lines.zh: 距离够近了，我准备下口。
lines.en: Close enough now — I'm ready to bite.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底，尽量不扬起泥。
lines.en: I hug the bottom, trying not to stir silt.

lines.zh: 那条追我的鱼忽然停了。
lines.en: The fish chasing me suddenly stopped.

lines.zh: 我还能再绕三圈。
lines.en: I can circle three more times.

lines.zh: 水那么浅，你追不上我。
lines.en: Water's shallow. You won't catch me.

lines.zh: 我在这块石头后等着。
lines.en: I wait behind this stone.

lines.zh: 这泉眼没有浅滩可逃。
lines.en: This spring has no shallows to flee to.

lines.zh: 声波指着的区块，我一定到。
lines.en: Whatever block the sonar points at, I'll reach.

lines.zh: 水里的味道，我全尝得出。
lines.en: I can taste every scent in the water.

lines.zh: 我贴着砾石底跟过去。
lines.en: I skim the gravel bed after it.

lines.zh: 魔鳉的小身子里，藏着倔劲。
lines.en: In this tiny pupfish body hides a stubborn streak.

lines.zh: 你每一步都搅起泥。
lines.en: Every step you take stirs up mud.

lines.zh: 我只有两点生命也敢冲。
lines.en: Two points of health and I still charge.

lines.zh: 我用头顶你，这已经是我全部的力气。
lines.en: I headbutt you; that's all the strength I have.

lines.zh: 咬一口苔藓可以，咬你不行。
lines.en: I'll bite moss, but I won't bite you.

lines.zh: 我只会撞，撞完就逃。
lines.en: I only ram, and then I flee.

lines.zh: 尾鳍甩在你手上，像被水草扫过。
lines.en: My tail flicks your hand like passing weeds.

lines.zh: 别逼我，我连两点生命都撑不住。
lines.en: Don't push me; I can't hold even two hearts.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，又立刻掉头。
lines.en: I charge, then turn right back.

lines.zh: 这一啄是为了那块苔藓。
lines.en: This peck is for that patch of moss.

lines.zh: 我撞在你指节上，自己先晕了。
lines.en: I hit your knuckle and daze myself first.

lines.zh: 追我的同伴挨了一记尾巴。
lines.en: The companion chasing me took a tail strike.

lines.zh: 我打不过，但我不让出石缝。
lines.en: I can't win, but I won't give up the crevice.

lines.zh: 我退开，又冲上去。
lines.en: I pull back and dart in again.

lines.zh: 我再啄一下，就一下。
lines.en: One more peck, just one.

lines.zh: 我撞你的脚踝，就一下。
lines.en: I ram your ankle, just once.

lines.zh: 这眼泉水只够我转身。
lines.en: This spring is barely wide enough for me to turn.

lines.zh: 魔鬼洞的水就这么多。
lines.en: Devil's Hole holds only so much water.

lines.zh: 再动，我就把你吐出来。
lines.en: Keep squirming and I'll spit you out.

lines.zh: 别把手伸到我的石缝里。
lines.en: Don't reach into my crevice.

lines.zh: 我用头撞你的指节。
lines.en: I butt my head against your knuckles.

lines.zh: 两点的身子，也敢撞你。
lines.en: Two points of life, and I still charge.

lines.zh: 我啄在你手上。
lines.en: I peck your hand.

lines.zh: 我从岩层深处的水里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in the water deep inside the rock.

lines.zh: 这一区块的地下水，就是我的出生地。
lines.en: This chunk's groundwater is where I was born.

lines.zh: 头顶是石头，四周也是石头。
lines.en: Stone above me, stone on every side.

lines.zh: 我第一次摆尾，搅起了细沙。
lines.en: My first tail-flick stirs up fine sand.

lines.zh: 苔藓就在旁边，我先吃一口。
lines.en: Moss is right here; I'll eat first.

lines.zh: 没有阳光，我照样认得路。
lines.en: No sunlight, and I still know the way.

lines.zh: 我是这池子里最新的一条。
lines.en: I'm the newest fish in this pool.

lines.zh: 水很暖，我慢慢舒开鳍。
lines.en: The water is warm; I slowly spread my fins.

lines.zh: 世界比我想的还要小。
lines.en: The world is even smaller than I thought.

lines.zh: 我听见远处同伴在追着玩。
lines.en: I hear companions chasing each other far off.

lines.zh: 泉眼冒着泡，我到了。
lines.en: The spring bubbles; I've arrived.

lines.zh: 我比一粒沙大不了多少。
lines.en: I'm barely bigger than a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 这水里，只有我和石头。
lines.en: In this water there is only me and the stones.

lines.zh: 这块石头的形状我认得。
lines.en: I know the shape of this stone.

lines.zh: 这池水太小，我翻个身。
lines.en: This pool is tiny — I roll over.

lines.zh: 这么小一汪水，就是全世界。
lines.en: This little puddle is my whole world.

lines.zh: 这口小池，是我全部的世界。
lines.en: This little pool is my whole world.

lines.zh: 这泉眼里又多了一尾。
lines.en: One more of us in the spring.

lines.zh: 这水温正好，我留下了。
lines.en: The water is just right; I stay.

lines.zh: 我先绕泉眼游一圈。
lines.en: First I swim one lap around the spring.

lines.zh: 水都烫了，我往深处钻。
lines.en: The water's gone hot; I burrow deeper.

lines.zh: 泉水烫手，我往上蹿。
lines.en: The spring turns scalding; I shoot up.

lines.zh: 被捞出水面又摔回去，我晕了。
lines.en: Scooped out and dropped back — I'm stunned.

lines.zh: 我摔在泉底的石头上。
lines.en: I drop onto the stones of the spring floor.

lines.zh: 我生在水里，却也有喘不上气的时候。
lines.en: I was born in water, yet sometimes I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 水里氧气太少了。
lines.en: Too little air in this water.

lines.zh: 冲击波把整池水掀了起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts the whole pool.

lines.zh: 才两点的命，经不起炸。
lines.en: Two points of life. No blasts, please.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的背鳍。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 一根细刺穿进水里。
lines.en: A thin spike cuts through the water.

lines.zh: 药水在水里散开，我的鳃发麻。
lines.en: The potion spreads through the water; my gills numb.

lines.zh: 邪术穿透了我两点的身子。
lines.en: Dark magic went straight through my two-point body.

lines.zh: 苔藓被啃光了，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: The moss is gone; hunger makes me restless.

lines.zh: 藻被吃光了，我还饿。
lines.en: The algae is eaten bare, and I'm still hungry.

lines.zh: 雷声透过岩层，震得我贴在石壁上。
lines.en: Thunder through the rock presses me to the wall.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，水都带电。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and the water carries a charge.

lines.zh: 水忽然没有了，我往下坠。
lines.en: The water vanishes and I fall.

lines.zh: 这洞没有底，我一直往下沉。
lines.en: No bottom in this hole, I keep sinking.
